direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale is very good, as they build the world well and allude to the overarching conflict as the story progresses; They do a very good job setting up the horror elements and making the movie feel very unsettling; The direction on a microscale is very good, as you can see what these characters are fighting for; The storytelling is good, as they sprinkle in aspects of the conflict that slowly snowball into a very unsettling ending; They build tension very well, as the horror elements make you feel very unsettling and make you slowly crawl back and hide in your seat

performance.comments: Gives a very multi-dimensional performance of the 'lady in the secluded house' trope; brings the best out of her castmates as each scene she is in feels very elevated
Is a real highlight in the cast as he shows a good amount of range and has good chemistry with the whole cast, especially for his age

cast.comments: A pretty small supporting cast, but everyone plays their role well and helps support moving the story forward; I really hope nobody was physically or psychologically hurt in the making of this movie, especially the kid who plays Oliver

story.comments: The concept is something we have definitely seen before, as it is your typical satanic cannibal cult movie set in a house in the middle of the woods; The plot structure is what you would expect for something that follows this trope, but it is still set up well; The character writing is very good, as they do paint these characters well and give them backstories so you understand what they are fighting for

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is sharp and does invoke emotions from you, especially during the intense scenes; The humor is surprisingly there as it does help alleviate the tension in some moments; The symbolism is somewhat prevalent as the movie does touch on issues like grief, loss, and family; The foreshadowing is good as they definitely sprinkle clues throughout the movie to help explain the reveal in the end

score.comments: Helps set the sinister horror tones and tension you want from a supernatural, gory horror movie like this

soundtrack.comments: Enjoyed they had Empire of the Sun

cinematography.comments: Well shot and helps tell the story; I enjoyed the use of blurring and steam throughout the movie as it helps emulate Piper's impaired vision

sound.comments: Helps build tension and make the movie feel uneasy;

visual_effects.comments: I enjoyed the use of practical effects, but the movie did a good job incorporating CGI to help paint the supernatural elements

makeup.comments: It helps show the gore these characters experienced, especially Oliver's character

review.climax: Climax is executed very well, as it is a buildup to this sinister, supernatural epiphany; these characters were going to experience the more they learned the truth
review.tone: Tone is very similar to other satanic, supernatural horror movies set in the middle of the woods, mixed with elements of gore and cannibal horror
review.overall: Overall, a very good horror movie that is carried by Sally Hawkins' performance and well-executed horror moments to create a satanic, gory movie that is profound, yet uneasy to watch; despite this movie being executed well on many fronts, like acting, direction, and makeup, this is definitely a story we have seen before as it is very similar to other satanic, cult movies that are set in a house stuck in the middle of the woods
